title: RHF/6-31++G** Geometry Optimizations for All Species
action: Construct initial molecular geometries for SiH₃F₂⁻ isomers 1 and 2, SiH₂F₃⁻ isomers 7 and 8, hydride ion H⁻, fluoride ion F⁻; build TS guesses for TS1 (from 1 + H⁻), TS2 and TS3 (from 2 + H⁻), TS4 (from 1 + F⁻), TS5 and TS6 (from 2 + F⁻), TS7 (from 7 + H⁻), TS8 and TS9 (from 8 + H⁻). Perform RHF/6-31++G** optimizations for all stable species and saddle-point searches for each TS, verifying one imaginary frequency per TS. Save all optimized coordinates in /app/outputs/optimized_geometries.xyz.
description: Optimized geometries for all reactants and transition states across the three reaction systems.

title: MP2 Single-Point Energies and All Barrier Calculations
action: Using the optimized geometries from step1, run MP2/6-31++G** single-point calculations for species: isomer 1, isomer 2, isomer 7, isomer 8, H⁻, F⁻, TS1–TS9. Compute barriers: barrier(TS) = (E_TS – E_corresponding_isomer – E_anion) × 627.509 kcal/mol (anion = H⁻ for TS1–TS3, TS7–TS9; anion = F⁻ for TS4–TS6). Compute isomer energy differences ΔE(2–1) and ΔE(8–7). Write all total energies, barriers, and differences to /app/outputs/results.json with keys as specified in the output schema.
description: File containing MP2 total energies, activation barriers, and isomer energy differences for H⁻ + SiH₃F₂⁻, F⁻ + SiH₃F₂⁻, and H⁻ + SiH₂F₃⁻.
output_schema: JSON object: isomer_1_energy_mp2, isomer_2_energy_mp2, E_Hminus_mp2, F_minus_energy_mp2, TS1_energy_mp2..TS9_energy_mp2, isomer_energy_difference_kcalmol (1 vs 2), isomer_7_8_energy_difference_kcalmol (7 vs 8), barrier_TS1_kcalmol..barrier_TS9_kcalmol, software_used.
